stories.title: Knox County Schools shares details for 3 proposed Farragut rezoning scenarios
stories.summary: Knox County officials unveiled three proposed rezoning scenarios to address overcrowding in Farragut schools.

stories.title: Knoxville residents question police about drones and license plate readers
stories.summary: At a Knoxville listening session, residents asked police who can watch a camera on University Avenue, how long officers keep plate records and who checks their work.

stories.title: Knoxville City Council considers stormwater fee to address $850M infrastructure needs
stories.summary: Knoxville City Council is debating a new stormwater fee to fund infrastructure repairs, aiming to avoid debt and prevent costly future failures.

stories.title: New sports and entertainment development in Farragut expected to open next year
stories.summary: "Prosperity Crossing," at 260 acres, is one of the largest private land development projects in Tennessee.

stories.title: Former Heritage High School football coach Joe Osovet denies all accusations against him
stories.summary: In front of a room full of news media and community members, the former coach gave his side of the story.

stories.title: Byington-Solway Technical Center graduates say they are upset with proposed change
stories.summary: Graduates of the center said the school provided them with a place to plan for the future and be themselves.

stories.title: Maryville employers recognized in statewide report for helping working parents with childcare
stories.summary: Three employers are getting statewide recognition for helping working parents balance their jobs and childcare through flexible schedules and support.

stories.title: Lenoir City Schools celebrates groundbreaking for $9M expansion
stories.summary: Lenoir City Schools broke ground on a $9 million school expansion. The project will add a gym, two classrooms and a sixth-grade science lab.

stories.title: Popular Smokies hiking trail renovated and reopened
stories.summary: The Smokies' Bullhead Trail reopens after a major rehabilitation funded by Friends of the Smokies, restoring safety and accessibility to the fire-damaged path.

stories.title: 'Remind a child that someone cares' | Mission of Hope launches 2026 Blue Barrel campaign Nov. 20
stories.summary: Mission of Hope's annual Blue Barrel campaign starts Friday, providing toys, clothes and essentials to thousands of Appalachian families in need this holiday season.

stories.title: Youngest Republican in Tennessee General Assembly elected for key leadership role in Tennessee House
stories.summary: At 26, State Rep. Noah Smith has been elected Assistant Floor Leader for Tennessee's House Republican Caucus, marking a notable rise from his school board origins.

stories.title: Knoxville City Council members push to provide more shelter access on cold nights
stories.summary: Councilmembers aim to expand shelter space for the unhoused during extreme weather, with a proposed ordinance raising temperature thresholds for emergency services.
